query:
WITH gone AS (
               DELETE FROM exam_result WHERE exam = ANY($1)
               RETURNING exam),
           kinds AS (
               SELECT e.kind AS kind, count(*) AS n
               FROM gone g JOIN exam e ON e.id = g.exam
               GROUP BY e.kind)
           UPDATE kind_ref k SET count = GREATEST(k.count - c.n, 0)
           FROM kinds c WHERE k.name = c.kind
